title: After the Debut: Bring the Brat

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huff… Puff… Aghhh!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (Oh, it's just so, so irritating! That was the real deal, and I couldn't concentrate at all!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (That was supposed to be my chance to find a new spell! This is no fun at all! It's just really, really annoying!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (I hate this!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, Sweep Tosho is rather irritated. The silent pressure seems to have gotten under her skin.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho! I'm sorry to bother you right after a race, but may I have a word?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Don't speak for me! I can make my own decisions!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: My! Um… W-would it be better to interview you another time?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: We can do it now. What's your question?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Oh, well, thank you very much. In that case, I'd like to ask about your next goal.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: …It's the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's a junior G1 held at Hanshin Racecourse. It's also a mile race, so it's well-suited to her.
choice_data_list: (…I wonder if she's already looked into it.)

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: You're going straight for a G1?! You must really be looking for a challenge…

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Haha. Well, you are at that age when people start wanting to showcase who they are. That said, Sweep…

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I believe this is your first interview, so I'm just going to give you a little advice. Instead of answering with one or two words, we'd appreciate it if you could share a little more with us.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Yeah. It's cuter if you smile and speak more cheerfully.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Nnngh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzzt… Bzzzt…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Who could that be at a time like this?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Father
text_block_list.text: Hey, Sweepy! Make sure you get plenty of rest today! Try and get used to going to bed even when you want to—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Beep! Click…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Grrrrr!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Every single person has been telling me what to do all day long!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I can't stand it! I'm not even gonna race anymore, so just leave me alone!

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Um… Sweep? It might be best for you to head home…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: No!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm not going home! I'm not moving an inch from this spot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She bolts herself to the spot, but after refusing to budge for some time, her eyelids start to droop, and she falls fast asleep.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While grappling with the major issue of how to interact with her going forward, I start to think about her next goal.
choice_data_list: She did mention the Hanshin J.F.
She did mention the Hanshin J.F.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Since she brought it up herself, I decide to make the Hanshin J.F. her next goal for now.
